about: Every sound and piece of music the game plays or ships, with its licence (docs/AUDIO_LICENSES.md). tests/audio-licenses.test.mjs refuses a shipped audio file or a sound in the game that is not listed here, and any licence not in `allowed`. A downloaded file is listed with its `file` (path under public/assets/audio/), `source` URL, `author`, `licence`, `checked` date and any `attribution`.

entries.composition: La Folía, the Spanish and Portuguese dance ground, 16th-17th century
entries.compositionEvidence: La Folía: a dance ground of the 16th-17th centuries, varied by Corelli (1700) among many; its makers died centuries ago. Public domain worldwide. The melody over it is the game's own.
